name: Ideas & Talks
tagline: A talks-hub template for a nonprofit that shares ideas and asks for support.
description: A video-forward home for an ideas-and-talks nonprofit — a big idea-statement hero over a grid of talk cards, a themes browse, a live journal of essays, and a bespoke bylined talk page, in a clean warm-white one-coral theme. Modelled on the talks-hub archetype; shipped as The Commons. Ships a light membership store (an annual membership, an anthology, a notebook) to demonstrate content + commerce together.
